title: Referrals and Authorizations Home Health Visits Front-Loaded for an Institutional Admission Source
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, an institutional admission source front-loads visits on an authorization issued after reconsideration, for authorization types that require the patient to be homebound (the Home Health Care Authorization).

## Records read

From the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines: whether a skilled nursing facility line and whether an acute inpatient admission line of the patient are dated in the last month.

## Rule (types that require the patient to be homebound)

| Skilled nursing facility line in the last month | Acute inpatient admission line in the last month | Visits added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 6 |
| yes | no | 3 |
| no | yes | 3 |
| no | no | 0 |

In words: where both a skilled nursing facility line and an acute inpatient admission line of the patient are dated in the last month, six visits are added; where only one of the two is dated in the last month, three visits are added; otherwise none are added. For a type that does not require the patient to be homebound, none are added under this rule.

## Case (hypothetical)

A Home Health Care Authorization is issued after reconsideration for a patient whose TRICARE Select lines show a skilled nursing facility stay dated two weeks ago and no hospital admission in the last month: 3 visits are added.
